pilot: runs/neural_foundation_pilot_v1: 28 trials, 2 seeds, 64 ticks; retained separately. Pilot checked pipeline and revealed null/limited movement, not a success criterion. No goal rewards or locomotion assistance were introduced in response.
primary_comparisons: Paired same-seed plastic_on versus plastic_off and random; other ablations descriptive. Assert identical initial state hashes and founder genotype IDs across matched conditions.
measurements: early and late quarter nutrient intake
distance in sites and recoil events
uncertainty: Report all seed values, paired differences, means, sample standard deviations and deterministic 95% percentile bootstrap intervals. Eight seeds and multiple exploratory contrasts limit inference; do not turn a positive metric into purposeful learned behaviour.

verdict_rules.motor_activity: continuous command diversity and physically integrated joint rates; not smooth pixels alone
verdict_rules.locomotion: measured centre-of-mass displacement caused by modeled reaction mass; not evidence of swimming
verdict_rules.experience_change: plastic state and behaviour differ with experience, separate from genotype changes
verdict_rules.learned_competence: not established by physiology alone; retain NOT_DEMONSTRATED without appropriate causal generalization/retention tests
verdict_rules.genetic_divergence: inherited mutated genome and distinct fresh-state common-garden response
verdict_rules.evolutionary_adaptation: not established by mutation or offspring differences alone
verdict_rules.construction_or_tunnelling: physical excavation events are not evidence of purposeful learned construction or tunnelling

performance: 64 World::tick steps on a 16^3 grid at initial populations 1,16,64,192,512. Includes atomic cloning and integrity audits; excludes rendering and snapshot hashing. These are local measurements, not whole-world scalability guarantees.
failure_policy: retain every condition/seed and pipeline failure; never overwrite prior run directories

amendments.reason: Final review found recoil impulses missing from reported acceleration. Correct acceleration includes all within-tick impulse velocity changes as well as drag. Regression test added; no reward, genotype, controller or scenario parameter tuning.
amendments.prior_data_status: PRESERVED; acceleration feedback incomplete. First-dataset nulls remain part of the record.
